title: AxialResNet implementation slow on TPU hardware
description: The authors' implementation of AxialResNet, similar to the open-source implementation, is very slow on TPUs, preventing extensive large-scale experiments with this baseline.
canonical_description: axial attention implementation slow on specialized hardware accelerators

evidence.quote: In our experiments, we reproduced the scores reported in~[CITE:wang2020axial] in terms of accuracy, however, our implementation, similar to the open-source implementation, is very slow on TPUs.
